mapper.select: select SUM(case when receipt_type = 3 and receipt_status = 2 and create_time = STR_TO_DATE(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') then total_amount when receipt_type = 4 and receipt_status = 2 and create_time = STR_TO_DATE(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') then -total_amount else 0 end) as dailySalesAmount, SUM(case when receipt_type = 3 and receipt_status = 2 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 1 month) then total_amount when receipt_type = 4 and receipt_status = 2 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 1 month) then -total_amount else 0 end) as lastMonthSalesAmount, SUM(case when receipt_type = 3 and receipt_status = 2 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 6 month) then total_amount when receipt_type = 4 and receipt_status = 2 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 6 month) then -total_amount else 0 end) as lastSixMonthsSalesAmount, SUM(case when receipt_type = 3 and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(now()) then total_amount when receipt_type = 4 and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(now()) then -total_amount else 0 end) as thisYearSalesAmount, SUM(case when receipt_type = 3 and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(date_sub(now(), interval 1 year)) then total_amount when receipt_type = 4 and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(date_sub(now(), interval 1 year)) then -total_amount else 0 end) as lastYearSalesAmount, SUM(case when receipt_type = 3 and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(date_sub(now(), interval 2 year)) then total_amount when receipt_type = 4 and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(date_sub(now(), interval 2 year)) then -total_amount else 0 end) as lastTwoYearsSalesAmount, SUM(case when receipt_type in (2, 3, 6, 9) and receipt_status = 2 and create_time = STR_TO_DATE(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') then total_amount when receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 10) and receipt_status = 2 and create_time = STR_TO_DATE(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d') then -total_amount else 0 end) as dailyGrossProfit, SUM(case when receipt_type in (2, 3, 6, 9) and receipt_status = 2 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 1 month) then total_amount when receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 10) and receipt_status = 2 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 1 month) then -total_amount else 0 end) as lastMonthGrossProfit, SUM(case when receipt_type in (2, 3, 6, 9) and receipt_status = 2 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 6 month) then total_amount when receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 10) and receipt_status = 2 and create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 6 month) then -total_amount else 0 end) as lastSixMonthsGrossProfit, SUM(case when receipt_type in (2, 3, 6, 9) and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(now()) then total_amount when receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 10) and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(now()) then -total_amount else 0 end) as thisYearGrossProfit, SUM(case when receipt_type in (2, 3, 6, 9) and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(date_sub(now(), interval 1 year)) then total_amount when receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 10) and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(date_sub(now(), interval 1 year)) then -total_amount else 0 end) as lastYearGrossProfit, SUM(case when receipt_type in (2, 3, 6, 9) and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(date_sub(now(), interval 2 year)) then total_amount when receipt_type in (1, 4, 5, 10) and receipt_status = 2 and year(create_time) = year(date_sub(now(), interval 2 year)) then -total_amount else 0 end) as lastTwoYearsGrossProfit from head_receipt

select -- 采购入库单据待审核 (select count(*) from head_receipt where receipt_type = 1 and receipt_status = 1) AS purchaseInReceipt, -- 采购退库单据待审核 (select count(*) from head_receipt where receipt_type = 2 and receipt_status = 1) AS purchaseOutReceipt, -- 销售出库单据待审核 (select count(*) from head_receipt where receipt_type = 3 and receipt_status = 1) AS salesOutReceipt, -- 销售退库单据待审核 (select count(*) from head_receipt where receipt_type = 4 and receipt_status = 1) AS salesRefundReceipt, -- 其他入库单据待审核 (select count(*) from head_receipt where receipt_type = 5 and receipt_status = 1) AS otherInReceipt, -- 其他出库单据待审核 (select count(*) from head_receipt where receipt_type = 6 and receipt_status = 1) AS otherOutReceipt, -- 库存调拨单据待审核 (select count(*) from head_receipt where receipt_type = 7 and receipt_status = 1) AS otherTransferReceipt, -- 库存盘点单据待审核 (select count(*) from head_receipt where receipt_type = 8 and receipt_status = 1) AS stocktakingReceipt
mapper.sql: SELECT p.product_id, p.product_code, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.product_specifications, p.measure_unit, p.producer, ip.plan_quantity as inventory_qty, p.upper_limit, p.lower_limit, pt.product_type_name FROM product p JOIN product_type pt ON pt.product_type_id = p.product_type left JOIN inventory_product ip ON ip.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN detail_receipt d ON p.product_id = d.product_id JOIN head_receipt h ON h.systematic_receipt = d.systematic_receipt WHERE ip.plan_quantity > 0
mapper.select: and not exists (select 1 from head_receipt h2 where h2.systematic_receipt = h.systematic_receipt and h.receipt_type = 3 and h2.invoice_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 3 month)) and exists (select 1 from head_receipt h2 where h2.systematic_receipt = h.systematic_receipt and h2.invoice_date < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 3 month))

and not exists (select 1 from head_receipt h2 where h2.systematic_receipt = h.systematic_receipt and h.receipt_type = 3 and h2.invoice_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 6 month)) and exists (select 1 from head_receipt h2 where h2.systematic_receipt = h.systematic_receipt and h2.invoice_date < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 6 month))

and not exists (select 1 from head_receipt h2 where h2.systematic_receipt = h.systematic_receipt and h.receipt_type = 3 and h2.invoice_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 12 month)) and exists (select 1 from head_receipt h2 where h2.systematic_receipt = h.systematic_receipt and h2.invoice_date < DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), interval 12 month))
